subject: Re: Broken syrup bottles in Thursday's delivery
body:
That's grand, thanks Marieke, the credit is perfect.

While I have you, can you send these for tomorrow:

house blend x3
haverland oat x3
whole milk 1L x3
vanilla syrup x4 (well wrapped this time!)
hazelnut syrup x1
12oz cups x1
12oz lids x1

Thanks,
Niamh

On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 10:02, Harbor Lane Orders <orders@harborlane-provisions.nl> wrote:
> Hi Niamh,
>
> So sorry about that, and thanks for letting us know. I've put a credit
> note through for the 2 vanilla syrups and asked the warehouse to pack
> glass separately from now on.
>
> Kind regards,
> Marieke
> Harbor Lane Provisions | Customer Service
>
> On Mon, 12 Oct 2026 at 16:20, Niamh O'Connell <niamh.bothar@gmail.com> wrote:
>> Hi there,
>>
>> Just letting you know 2 of the 4 vanilla syrups in last Thursday's

>>

>>

>> Niamh
>> Bóthar Café, Galway
